def encode(text):
    out, i = '', 0
    while i < len(text):
        j = i+1
        while j < len(text) and text[j] == text[i]: j += 1
        count = j-i
        out += '%'+text[i]+str(count) if count >= 3 else text[i:j]
        i = j
    return out

steps.text: Repeat while i is less than the length of text.
Repeat while j is less than the length of text and text[j] equals text[i]. Increase j by 1.
Increase out by '%' + text[i] + str(count) if count is at least 3; otherwise text[i:j].
